## Technology Weights

```{r}
tech_weights <- tribble(
  ~technology,                            ~weight,
  "Body-Worn Cameras",                     1.67,
  "Cell-Site Simulator",                   3.67,
  "Drones",                                3.67,
  "Camera Registry",                       3.83,
  "Predictive Policing",                   3.83,
  "Real-Time Crime Center",                4.33,
  "Gunshot Detection",                     4.50,
  "Automated License Plate Readers",       4.50,
  "Face Recognition",                      4.67,
  "Third-Party Investigative Platforms",   4.83,
  "Video Analytics",                       4.83,
  "Fusion Center",                         4.83
)

anti_join(atlas_clean, tech_weights, by = "technology") |> count(technology)
```

## Merging Datasets

```{r}
data("fips_codes")   # state, state_code, state_name, county, county_code

fips_xwalk <- fips_codes |>
  transmute(
    state_name  = str_to_title(state_name),
    state_name  = case_when(
      state_name == "U.s. Virgin Islands" ~ "Virgin Islands",
      TRUE ~ state_name
    ),
    state_abb   = state,
    county_name = str_to_title(
      str_remove(county, 
        regex(" County$| Parish$| Borough$| City And Borough$| Census Area$| Municipality$| Municipio$| Municipality County$| Islands?$",
              ignore_case = TRUE))),
    GEOID       = paste0(state_code, county_code)
  )
```

```{r}
# Attach county_clean + GEOID to every individual record, before any aggregation
atlas_county <- atlas_clean |>
  mutate(
    county_clean = str_to_title(
      str_remove(county,
        regex(" County$| Parish$| Borough$| City And Borough$| Census Area$| Municipality$| Municipio$| Municipality County$| Island$",
              ignore_case = TRUE))
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(fips_xwalk, by = c("state" = "state_name", "county_clean" = "county_name"))


# Rebuild the unmatched list at record level, with counts of how many rows each affects
unmatched_review <- atlas_county |>
  filter(is.na(GEOID)) |>
  count(state, county, sort = TRUE)

print(unmatched_review, n = 30)
```

```{r}
atlas_county <- atlas_county |> 
  left_join(tech_weights, by = "technology") |>
  mutate(weight = replace_na(weight, 1)) |>
  group_by(GEOID) |>                        
  summarise(
    state                  = first(state),    
    county                 = first(county),   
    n_records              = n(),
    n_agencies             = n_distinct(agency),
    n_tech_types           = n_distinct(technology),
    raw_weighted_index     = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fr                   = sum(technology == "Face Recognition"),
    n_alpr                 = sum(technology == "Automated License Plate Readers"),
    n_pred                 = sum(technology == "Predictive Policing"),
    n_bwc                  = sum(technology == "Body-Worn Cameras"),
    n_gunshot              = sum(technology == "Gunshot Detection"),
    n_rtcc                 = sum(technology == "Real-Time Crime Center"),
    n_drone                = sum(technology == "Drones"),
    n_cell_sim             = sum(technology == "Cell-Site Simulator"),
    n_vid_analytics        = sum(technology == "Video Analytics"),
    n_cam_reg              = sum(technology == "Camera Registry"),
    n_investigative        = sum(technology == "Third-Party Investigative Platforms"),
    n_fusion               = sum(technology == "Fusion Center"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Review join quality — how many counties matched?
cat("Matched:  ", sum(!is.na(atlas_county$GEOID)), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Unmatched:", sum( is.na(atlas_county$GEOID)), "\n")
```

```{r}
atlas_county |> filter(is.na(GEOID)) |> select(state, county) |> print(n = 30)
```

## Weighted Surveillance Index

```{r}
analysis_df <- acs |>
  left_join(
    atlas_county |> st_drop_geometry() |> 
      select(GEOID, n_records, n_agencies, n_tech_types, raw_weighted_index,
             starts_with("n_")),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Counties not in Atlas get 0, not NA
    across(c(n_records, n_agencies, n_tech_types, raw_weighted_index, starts_with("n_")),
           ~ replace_na(., 0)),
    weighted_index_per100k = raw_weighted_index / total_pop * 100000
  )

analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    total_counties  = n(),
    with_index      = sum(weighted_index_per100k > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    without_index   = sum(weighted_index_per100k == 0),
    pct_without     = scales::percent(without_index / total_counties, accuracy = 0.01)
  )
```

## Analysis Dataset

```{r}
# Ground truth: total counties per state from fips_codes
total_counties_by_state <- fips_codes |>
  distinct(state_name, county) |>
  count(state_name, name = "total_counties")

# Counties with a surveillance index: deduplicate by GEOID to avoid
# multi-county string rows (e.g. "Cook County, Kane County") inflating counts
state_coverage <- atlas_county |>
  filter(!is.na(GEOID)) |>                        # matched counties only
  distinct(state, GEOID) |>                       # one row per unique county
  count(state, name = "n_with_surveillance") |>
  left_join(total_counties_by_state, by = c("state" = "state_name")) |>
  filter(!is.na(total_counties)) |>
  mutate(
    pct_coverage = n_with_surveillance / total_counties,
    state        = fct_reorder(state, pct_coverage)
  )

ggplot(state_coverage, aes(x = pct_coverage, y = state)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C72B0") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(pct_coverage, accuracy = 1)),
    hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Surveillance data coverage by state",
    subtitle = "Percentage of counties with at least one surveillance record",
    x        = "% of counties with a surveillance index",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# Pull ALL US territories/states — no exclusions
county_shp_all <- counties(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022) |>
  select(GEOID, STATEFP, geometry)

state_shp_all <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022) |>
  select(STATEFP, geometry)

# Join index data onto the full geometry set
county_map_data_all <- county_shp_all |>
  left_join(
    analysis_df |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(GEOID, weighted_index_per100k) |>
      mutate(log_index = log1p(weighted_index_per100k)),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) |>
  mutate(log_index_plot = if_else(weighted_index_per100k == 0, NA_real_, log_index))

# Split into regional subsets
continental <- county_map_data_all |> filter(!STATEFP %in% c("02", "15", "72", "78", "60", "66", "69"))
alaska      <- county_map_data_all |> filter(STATEFP == "02")
hawaii      <- county_map_data_all |> filter(STATEFP == "15")
puerto_rico <- county_map_data_all |> filter(STATEFP == "72")

# Shared scale limits so all panels use identical color mapping
index_range <- range(county_map_data_all$log_index_plot, na.rm = TRUE)

figure_base_size <- 16

make_panel <- function(data, state_borders = NULL, show_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = log_index_plot), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "magma", na.value = "grey90", direction = -1,
      limits = index_range,
      name = "log(index\nper 100k + 1)",
      guide = if (show_legend) "colourbar" else "none"
    ) +
    theme_thesis_map(base_size = figure_base_size)
  if (!is.null(state_borders)) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = state_borders, fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  p
}

panel_continental <- make_panel(
  continental,
  state_shp_all |> filter(!STATEFP %in% c("02","15","72","78","60","66","69")),
  show_legend = TRUE
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5))

panel_alaska <- make_panel(alaska) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-170, -130), ylim = c(51, 72), expand = FALSE)

panel_hawaii <- make_panel(hawaii) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-160.5, -154.5), ylim = c(18.5, 22.5), expand = FALSE)

panel_pr <- make_panel(puerto_rico) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-67.5, -65.2), ylim = c(17.9, 18.6), expand = FALSE)

final_surveillance_index_map <- panel_continental +
  inset_element(panel_alaska, left = 0.0,  bottom = 0.0,  right = 0.30, top = 0.30) +
  inset_element(panel_hawaii, left = 0.28, bottom = 0.0,  right = 0.46, top = 0.16) +
  inset_element(panel_pr,     left = 0.82, bottom = 0.0,  right = 1.0,  top = 0.18) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Surveillance Index by County",
    subtitle = "Log-transformed index per 100,000 population | Grey = no surveillance records",
    caption  = "Source: Atlas of Surveillance · ACS 2022 5-year estimates. Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico not shown to scale.",
    theme    = theme_thesis_map(base_size = figure_base_size) +
               theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5))
  )

save_figure(final_surveillance_index_map, "surveillance_index_map.png", width = 12, height = 8)
```

### Exclusions

```{r}
territory_check <- tibble(
  STATEFP = c("02","15","72","78","60","66","69"),
  name    = c("Alaska","Hawaii","Puerto Rico","US Virgin Islands","American Samoa","Guam","N. Mariana Islands")
)

territory_check |>
  left_join(
    county_map_data_all |> st_drop_geometry() |> count(STATEFP, name = "n_in_map_geometry"),
    by = "STATEFP"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    atlas_clean |> count(state, name = "n_atlas_records") |>
      mutate(STATEFP = case_when(
        state == "Alaska" ~ "02", state == "Hawaii" ~ "15", state == "Puerto Rico" ~ "72",
        state == "Virgin Islands" ~ "78", state == "American Samoa" ~ "60",
        state == "Guam" ~ "66", state == "Northern Mariana Islands" ~ "69", TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) |> select(-state),
    by = "STATEFP"
  )
```
